reuse.why: Calls the existing shared getExpectedScheduleAmount, the same helper forecasts, schedule-template and schedules/app already use, with the raw _amount.

duplication.why: No logic duplicated; the range/number/missing dispatch stays in the shared helper.

placement.why: The field is computed in scheduleModel.toExternal in api-models.ts, where the API's external shape is built.

scope.why: One field in the API model plus a focused test.

maintainability.why: Clean and small, but expectedAmount is added as a required field to APIScheduleEntity, which is also the input type of api/schedule-create and update, so callers creating schedules are now typed to pass a derived value.
